# Declarative document classification: which format a report is, read from its pages.
# No rules yet, so nothing is classified. The minimal form, a page and a step under it:
#
# 1:
#   ACME-EN24: {text: '^ACME FUNDS$'}
#
# `text` is literal text, not a regex: only a leading ^ and a trailing $ anchor it.
# See https://docs.freeports.org/en/latest/guides/formats/repository.html
